virt.Battery (100) – Aggregator Pipeline from 3 Shunts + JK-BMS
info:
## Overview

This flow aggregates data from **3 SmartShunts (YiXiang #1/#2/#3)**
and the **JK-BMS** into a single virtual battery
`com.victronenergy.battery/100`.

### Sources
| Source | Service | Data |
|--------|---------|------|
| YiXiang #1 | `/288` | SOC, Voltage, Current |
| YiXiang #2 | `/274` | SOC, Voltage, Current |
| YiXiang #3 | `/290` | SOC, Voltage, Current |
| JK-BMS | `/512` | Temperature, CCL/DCL/CVL, Min/MaxCellVoltage, Min/MaxCellId, Alarms |

### Aggregation Logic
| Path | Calculation |
|------|-------------|
| `/Soc` | Average of 3 shunts (stale filter 60 s) |
| `/Dc/0/Current` | Sum of all 3 shunts |
| `/Dc/0/Voltage` | ≥ 51.7 V → MAX (overcharge protection), < 51.7 V → MIN (deep discharge protection), rate limiter max 0.03 V/cycle |
| `/Dc/0/Power` | virt_voltage × virt_current |
| `/Dc/0/Temperature` | direct from JK-BMS |
| `/Info/*` | direct from JK-BMS (CCL/DCL/CVL) |
| `/System/*` | direct from JK-BMS (Min/Max Cell V & Id) |
| `/Alarms/*` | direct from JK-BMS |

### Voltage Logic
Voltage selection is based solely on the current voltage level,
not on current direction:

- **≥ 51.7 V (normal operation):** Highest shunt voltage (MAX) → protects
  the weakest string from overcharge at end of charge.
- **< 51.7 V (deep discharge):** Lowest shunt voltage (MIN) → protects
  the weakest string from deep discharge.

51.7 V corresponds to 16 × 3.23 V/cell (lower LiFePO4 plateau knee).
Normal operation (54.4–55.2 V) is always in the MAX branch.

A rate limiter (max 0.03 V/cycle) prevents voltage jumps
that could cause ESS regulation jitter.

### Deadbands & Heartbeats
| Block | Deadband | Heartbeat |
|-------|----------|-----------|
| SOC | ≥ 0.1 % | 60 s |
| Current | ≥ 0.1 A | 30 s |
| Voltage | ≥ 0.01 V | 30 s |
| Power | ≥ 5 W | 30 s |
| BMS Info | on value change | 30 s |
| Alarms | on value change | 10 s |

### Design Goals
- Minimal D-Bus write operations (aggregator pattern throughout)
- Multi-value payloads instead of single writes
- Self-documenting function nodes with status displays
- Stale detection for SOC (faulty shunt is automatically excluded)
- Heartbeat as keep-alive for each virtual sub-system
